description: AiModel is a base class for defining the AiModel hierarchy (TM Forum TMF915 Ai Management 4.0.0, Swagger definition AiModel; attribute names kept verbatim except the NGSI-LD reserved terms / JSON-LD keywords renamed with a tmf prefix (id, @type, @baseType, @schemaLocation, ...); deprecated attributes left out.)

hasStarted.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF915_AIManagementSuite/blob/v4.0.0/TMF915-AIManagement-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/AiModel/properties/hasStarted'. If TRUE, this Service has already been started

isBundle.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF915_AIManagementSuite/blob/v4.0.0/TMF915-AIManagement-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/AiModel/properties/isBundle'. If true, the service is a ServiceBundle which regroup a service hierachy. If false, the service is a 'atomic' service (hierachy leaf).

isServiceEnabled.description: Property. If FALSE and hasStarted is FALSE, this particular Service has NOT been enabled for use - if FALSE and hasStarted is TRUE then the service has failed

serviceType.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF915_AIManagementSuite/blob/v4.0.0/TMF915-AIManagement-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/AiModel/properties/serviceType'. Business type of the service

startDate.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF915_AIManagementSuite/blob/v4.0.0/TMF915-AIManagement-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/AiModel/properties/startDate'. Date when the service starts

startMode.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF915_AIManagementSuite/blob/v4.0.0/TMF915-AIManagement-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/AiModel/properties/startMode'. This attribute is an enumerated integer that indicates how the Service is started, such as: 0: Unknown; 1: Automatically by the managed environment; 2: Automatically by the owning device; 3: Manually by the Provider of the Service; 4: Manually by a Customer of the Provider; 5: Any of the above

aiModelSpecification.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF915_AIManagementSuite/blob/v4.0.0/TMF915-AIManagement-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/AiModel/properties/aiModelSpecification'. ResourceSpecificationRef.description: Resources are physical or non-physical components (or some combination of these) within an enterprise's infrastructure or inventory. They are typically consumed or used by services (for example a physical port assigned to a service) or contribute to the realization of a Product (for example, a SIM card). They can be drawn from the Application, Computing and Network domains, and include, for example, Network Elements, software, IT systems, content and information, and technology components. A ResourceSpecification is an abstract base class for representing a generic means for implementing a particular type of Resource. In essence, a ResourceSpecification defines the common attributes and relationships of a set of related Resources, while Resource defines a specific instance that is based on a particular ResourceSpecification.
